def remove_Occ(s, char):
    first_idx = s.find(char)
    if first_idx == -1:
        return s
    
    # Create a string without the first occurrence
    temp_s = s[:first_idx] + s[first_idx+1:]
    
    # Find the last occurrence in the new string
    last_idx = temp_s.rfind(char)
    if last_idx == -1:
        return temp_s
    
    # Return string without the last occurrence
    return temp_s[:last_idx] + temp_s[last_idx+1:]
